items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: So when let’s say someone like Shearing came here, Ronnie Ball, the bebop piano player, came here, of course Victor Feldman.

ctx.x: I don’t know how to ask this question, but do British people resent the fact that a lot of your best artists seem to come here and stay?

Well originally I think we felt great pride you see. The idea was that if you could make it in the States, by golly that was a tremendous accolade. Because after all America was the home of the music. So when let’s say someone like Shearing came here, Ronnie Ball, the bebop piano player, came here, of course Victor Feldman.
